C0600.title: Shiyan, Hubei Dismantles a 'Running Points Money Laundering' Gang Involving Over 20 Million Yuan
C0600.summary: Between April and June 2021, police in Shiyan, Hubei dismantled a seven-member gang that directly provided 'running points money laundering' services for overseas fraud groups. The gang incited dozens of bar employees in Shiyan to provide bank cards and WeChat accounts, recruited unemployed individuals as core members, and exercised unified management.
